description: Find the implementation behind a proxy contract on Mantle: reads the EIP-1967 implementation, beacon and admin slots, EIP-1822 (UUPS), the older OpenZeppelin layout and EIP-1167 minimal-proxy bytecode, and names the kind found. Use before trusting or decoding a contract whose code can be swapped by its admin; for a fuller risk verdict use contract_risk. A malformed address is 400; an address without code is 404, both uncharged. Example: address=0x09Bc4E0D864854c6aFB6eB9A9cdF58aC190D0dF9. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: mantle_proxy
title: Proxy implementation, Mantle
